name: Ioroi Tamae
source: Ioroi has a very big complex about her appearance and personality. On top of that, she has rarely spoken to the opposite sex (other than her father), so she is afraid of men. However, since she has a strong inquisitive mind by nature, her curiosity is higher than most people's. Her eyesight is so weak that it interferes with her daily life, making her required to wear glasses.
